name: turbo-upload-conformance
description: Not published. Cross-checks @ardrive/turbo-upload against the implementations it must agree with: @dha-team/arbundles for type 1, @ardrive/turbo-sdk for type 4, vectors from the x402 package for x402 payments. Its dependencies are this directory's, never the package's.

scripts.test: npm run verify && npm run type4:check && npm run cross && npm run wire && npm run x402:check
